scope: S0 opaque raw bundle CLI and frozen host import resolver; no runtime replacement or E2 acceptance
commands: nupp-vm native raw BUNDLE INPUT OUTPUT

bundle.entry: unsigned aligned byte offset in code
bundle.code: opaque code file, relative to bundle parent or absolute
bundle.data: opaque data file, relative to bundle parent or absolute
bundle.imports: ordered array of existing host symbol names
bundle.outputWords: unsigned count of little-endian u64 output words

inputOutput: Binary little-endian u64 arrays. No scalar signatures, textual number arguments or instruction parsing. Output is written after execution returns successfully.

layoutDigest.encoding: ASCII domain nupp-raw-layout-v1 followed by NUL; host architecture followed by NUL; host OS followed by NUL; exact native layouts JSON bytes; little-endian u32 OBJECT_ABI; little-endian u64 CALL_ABI
layoutDigest.independentReconstruction: Python hashlib over the separate native layouts command output and explicit ABI28/callABI1 matches the raw-layout output

coverage: assembler-checked raw C entry invokes the actual OS page-size function and returns its u64 result
all88 import names exactly match undefined imports of the frozen155e core object and resolve nonzero
bundle-relative paths work from another current directory
bad versions/types/unknown fields, architecture, digest, entry bounds/alignment, import names/count, file cap, output cap and incomplete input words reject
output sentinel is preserved on failed validation

formatter: nupp fmt rejects Rust syntax; invocation preserved in build/s0-loader/bundle-format.log. New Rust files pass rustfmt. Existing Rust files have narrow routing/serialization extraction edits.
fullCoreProvider: Still absent. The earlier105-export inventory remains the full routing requirement. Three-entry-only substitution cannot close E2.
